newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dollar, NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends steady vs dollar, NBH basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed virtually unchanged against the dollar and remained steady against the National Bank of Hungary's currency basket on Wednesday, dealers said.
The forint closed at 175.96/176.00 to the dollar, after standing 175.92/97 at opening and also at midday.

The Hungarian currency, which trades within a 4.5 percent intervention band against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the U.S. dollar, remained stuck to the bid, dealers said.
The forint was unlikely to distance itself from the bid as real interest rates represent a strong support base for the Hungarian currency, said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank.
